changelog.v0997_2_item_1: Farm description now visible on your Profile → Farms tab
changelog.v0997_2_item_2: Pi camera setup guide: new troubleshooting section and clearer SSH step
changelog.v0997_1_item_1: Weather forecast warnings now fully translated to Japanese with localised dates
changelog.v0997_1_item_2: Cross-browser testing expanded (WebKit / Safari added) and automated accessibility scans in place
changelog.v0997_item_1: LICENSE file added (MIT) — the project now has a clear open-source licence
changelog.v0997_item_2: Resolved 9 security advisories in our dependencies (no known exploit impact for LitCrop users)
changelog.v0997_item_3: Added SECURITY.md with a private disclosure channel for reporting vulnerabilities
changelog.v0996_5_item_1: Your capture-interval setting from the web now actually controls how often your Pi takes photos
changelog.v0996_5_item_2: Device status refreshes every 5 minutes on the device card (was every 30)
changelog.v0996_3_item_1: A bare Pi Zero WH without a battery HAT is now correctly classified as Class-1 (was showing as Class-2 incorrectly)
changelog.v0996_2_item_1: WiFi signal shows as bars alongside the dBm reading, like the signal icon on your phone
changelog.v0996_2_item_2: Storage shows actual GB used and free with a progress bar, not just OK / LOW / FULL
changelog.v0996_2_item_3: Class-1 devices without a battery sensor now clearly show "No sensor" instead of an unexplained dash
changelog.v0996_1_item_1: Device install script now works reliably: `curl -sL https://litcrop.com/install.sh | bash`
changelog.v0996_item_1: Behind-the-scenes test and documentation improvements — no visible changes to the app
changelog.v0996_item_2: Tab keyboard navigation is more reliable on slower devices
changelog.v0995_item_1: Your display name now follows you across devices from sign-up
changelog.v0995_item_2: Profile tabs respond to keyboard Left / Right arrow keys
changelog.v0994_item_1: New users appear in the admin dashboard immediately on first login
changelog.v0994_item_2: Earthy-theme favicon in browser tabs and home-screen shortcuts
changelog.v0993_item_1: Admin stats refresh on demand; password toggle now works on mobile
changelog.v0992_item_1: Profile page reorganised into three tabs — Farms, You, System
changelog.v0991_item_1: Branded favicon and Progressive Web App install support
changelog.v099_item_1: Security tightened: inline scripts removed from the app
changelog.v099_item_2: New Pi Camera setup guide at /help/device-setup (EN and JP)
changelog.v098_item_1: Device install hardened: branch-aware downloads and hardware auto-detection
changelog.v097_item_1: Camera config round-trip — the UI now shows what the device actually applied
changelog.v096_item_1: Farms can be set public or private to control discoverability
changelog.v095_item_1: Day-grouped image history, timelapse filters, and invitation-only sign-up
changelog.v094_item_1: User notifications: email, in-app panel, and the notification bell
changelog.v093_item_1: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and the bug report form
changelog.v092_item_1: WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance across the app
changelog.v091_item_1: Custom domain litcrop.com and separate staging/production environments
changelog.v090_item_1: Production AWS resources, redesigned login, and device auth fix

legal.terms_intro: By using LitCrop, you agree to the following terms.
legal.terms_s1_body: By creating an account or using LitCrop, you accept these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
legal.terms_s2_body: LitCrop is a farm management platform that helps you organize crops, monitor beds, track work activity, and optionally capture images via connected devices. The service is provided as-is for agricultural planning and record-keeping.
legal.terms_s3_body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You must provide accurate information during registration. One person per account.
legal.terms_s4_body: You retain ownership of all content you create (farm data, images, diary entries). We do not sell your data. We store your data on secure cloud infrastructure (AWS) to provide the service.
legal.terms_s5_body: System administrators can view farm names, approximate locations (if provided), grid dimensions, and member counts for platform management and support purposes. Administrators cannot modify your farm data without your consent.
legal.terms_s6_body: LitCrop may offer AI-powered features (crop advice, chat assistance). When enabled, your farm context data (crop types, weather, diary entries) may be processed by third-party AI providers. No personally identifiable information is shared with AI providers.
legal.terms_s7_body: Do not use LitCrop for illegal activities, to upload harmful content, or to attempt unauthorized access to other accounts or system resources.
legal.terms_s8_body: LitCrop is not a substitute for professional agricultural advice. Crop recommendations, weather data, and AI suggestions are provided for informational purposes only. We are not liable for crop losses, equipment damage, or decisions made based on data from this platform.
legal.terms_s9_body: We aim to keep LitCrop available but cannot guarantee uninterrupted service. We may perform maintenance, updates, or changes at any time. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.
legal.terms_s10_body: We may update these terms. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance. Significant changes will be communicated via the What's New page.
legal.privacy_intro: Your privacy matters. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and who can see it.
legal.privacy_s1_body: Account information (email, display name, preferred role), farm data (name, location, beds, crops), diary entries, uploaded images, device configuration, and usage preferences (language, theme, temperature unit).
legal.privacy_s2_body: Farm location text (city or region) is required for weather features. GPS coordinates (latitude/longitude) are optional and only collected if you provide them. Coordinates enable elevation-based crop advice and map features. You can add or remove coordinates at any time from farm settings.
legal.privacy_s3_body_you: You: Full access to all your farm data, images, and diary entries.
legal.privacy_s3_body_members: Farm members: Can view shared farm data (beds, images, diary) based on their role (owner, staff).
legal.privacy_s3_body_admin: System administrators: Can view farm names, member counts, and approximate locations for platform management. Admins cannot edit your data.
legal.privacy_s3_body_public: Public: No farm data is publicly accessible. There is no public directory of farms.
legal.privacy_s4_body: Your data is stored on Amazon Web Services (AWS) in the Asia Pacific region. Images are stored in S3 with automatic thumbnail generation. All data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS) and at rest.
legal.privacy_s5_body: When AI features are enabled, farm context (crop types, weather conditions, diary summaries) may be sent to Anthropic's Claude API for processing. No personally identifiable information (email, name) is included in AI requests.
legal.privacy_s6_body: Your data is retained while your account is active. When you delete your account, all associated data (farms you solely own, images, diary entries, preferences) is permanently deleted. Farms with other members are transferred to the next owner.
legal.privacy_s7_body: LitCrop uses browser local storage for session management, theme preferences, and farm selection. We do not use tracking cookies or third-party analytics.
legal.privacy_s8_body: You can view, edit, or delete your data at any time from the app. To delete your account, go to Profile > Delete Account. For data export requests, contact the administrator.
legal.privacy_s9_body: For privacy questions or data requests, contact the platform administrator.

guide.summary: LitCrop is a farm management platform for small-scale farmers. Track your crops from seed to harvest, monitor beds with camera devices, log daily activities in your farm diary, and review growth over time with timelapse playback.
guide.step1_desc: Set up your farm with a name and location. You'll start with a default bed grid that you can resize anytime.
guide.step2_desc: Select a bed in the grid and assign a crop. LitCrop will calculate your expected harvest date automatically.
guide.step3_desc: Take a photo from your phone, or set up a Raspberry Pi camera for automatic scheduled captures.
guide.step4_desc: Use the Farm Diary to record watering, fertilizing, weeding, and harvest activities with dates and costs.
guide.step5_desc: Use timelapse playback to watch your crops grow over time. Filter by device or date range.
